gloss: to have more losses than wins

definitions.gloss: to have more losses than wins; to end with a losing record
definitions.explanation: To finish a tournament, series, or period with more losses than wins. The standard term in sumo, where a wrestler who loses eight or more of fifteen bouts drops in rank.

examples.japanese: {今場所|こんばしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{負|ま}け{越|こ}した。
examples.english: He finished this tournament with a losing record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧{負|ま}け{越|こ}した。
examples.english: The yokozuna had a losing record for the first time.

examples.japanese: {二場所|ふたばしょ}{続|つづ}けて{負|ま}け{越|こ}した⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{番付|ばんづけ}→番付：15187_banzuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: He had losing records in two tournaments in a row, so he dropped far down the rankings.

notes:
⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧ (to lose) + ⟦{越|こ}す→越す：02282_kosu⟧ (to exceed). The noun is {負|ま}け{越|こ}し.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {負|ま}け{越|こ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: a losing record is settled (in sumo, the eighth loss)
- ⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{負|ま}け{越|こ}す: to finish with a heavily losing record
- {対戦成績|たいせんせいせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{負|ま}け{越|こ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to trail in the head-to-head record

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勝|か}ち{越|こ}す: to have more wins than losses — the opposite; in sumo, eight wins secure a promotion or keep the rank
